messages:
jess: heads up — noticed a bulk-tag edit just applied tags to rows from a different org. customer reported; I can reproduce in prod canary :cry:

mike: oh no. when did we roll the new bulk editor? :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy: frontend/bulk-editor 2026-03-18T09:12Z canary -> prod-a

jess: that lines up. repro steps: open insights > bulk select ~50 rows, filter by tag 'beta', then open tag editor and apply 'internal:review' — after api call some rows outside current org got the tag.

tara: can you paste the request payload / response and any logs? we need to know whether the UI sent wrong ids or server mis-scoped the operation.

jess: payload snippet:
```
POST /api/v1/bulk/tags
headers: { Authorization: Bearer x, X-Org-ID: 42 }
body: { ids: ["r:42:123","r:42:124","r:43:222"], tag: "internal:review" }
```
response: 200 OK, applied: 3

mike: wait — that body already has an id from org 43. how did it get there? should be filtered client-side by current view.

nate: possible race between selection cache and quick-switch UX. The selector stores a global selection set in localStorage keyed by `selection_key` without org prefix. if you quick-switch org before opening the tag modal, stale ids can survive.

liz: that sounds plausible. UI fix = prefix selection key with org id; server-side guard = validate all ids match X-Org-ID header and reject otherwise. we should add both.

sara: +1 for server guard. we can't rely on UI. Customers expect isolation.

mike: Agreed. Also add telemetry event when mismatched ids are dropped: `bulk_tag_id_mismatch` with counts so we can monitor regressions.

jess: I have a minimal repro script for internal QA:
```
# repro.sh
curl -X POST https://console.prod/api/v1/bulk/tags -H "X-Org-ID: 42" -d '{"ids":["r:43:100"],"tag":"t1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
```

tara: Owners? mike + liz for the short fixes. nate for investigating selection cache design and UX race. jess can drive customer comms and repro docs.

mike: I'll open a server PR to enforce org consistency and return 400 with a clear error code `ERR_ORG_MISMATCH`. will include a failing unit test.

liz: I'll push the UI prefix change and add a one-off migration that clears ambiguous selection keys in localStorage on next load. will also add a frontend integration test for quick-switch -> open modal flow.

nate: long-term: rethink selection store scope. maybe switch to ephemeral per-route state instead of global localStorage. filing an RFC.

sara: customer success: which customers hit this? jess?

jess: only one ticket so far (acct 421), but could be broader. I'm pinging ops for a query to find tag writes where tag was applied to entity with different org than caller.

infra-bot: query-start: SELECT count(*) FROM tag_events WHERE org_id != caller_org_id AND timestamp > now() - interval '24 hours'; id=Q-9982

infra-bot: query-done: rows=3 id=Q-9982

mike: 3 events in 24h — not great. we should temporarily rollback the frontend canary to prod-a while we patch.

deploy-bot: action: rollback frontend/bulk-editor canary -> previous at 2026-03-18T09:05Z initiated by mike

deploy-bot: rollback-complete: succeeded

jess: thanks. I'll open a CS template and reach out to the affected account with steps and remediation (we'll remove the stray tags and confirm fix).

tara: timeline? server PR first then UI? server guard should go first so even if UI still buggy it won't apply.

mike: yes server first. aiming to cut PR in next 30m, patch + deploy to prod in 2 hours if tests pass. alerting SRE.

nate: adding CI check to run a quick e2e that simulates quick-switch selection race; file a follow-up to adopt per-route selection state.

liz: once server patch is live, I'll ship the UI patch in the next deploy and then re-canary to 10% traffic with telemetry enabled.

sara: keep me in the loop for customer messaging. if more accounts surface, we'll escalate to incident and notify legal / security.

jess: noted. adding postmortem stub: cause=selection cache missing org context + canary rollout timing; impact=tag writes to wrong org; fixes=server guard, UI prefix, cleanup script; owners=[mike, liz, nate]; due=tomorrow EOD.

mike: thanks all. quick checklist in PRs: server returns error code, emits metric `bulk_tag_org_mismatch_total`, frontend clears stale selection keys on load, add tests.

jess: I'll attach the logs and the customer ticket link to PRs. closing loop when remediation complete. :thumbsup:
